paite: Hiai vualzawlna in ahi Pathian mipa Mosi in asih ma a Israel suante avualzawlna:
heading: Mosi In Israel Namte Avualzawl
english: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

paite: "Sinai a pan TOUPA ahong pai a, Seir a pan akiang uah athoukhia a, Paran tang a kipan hong vakkhia in, Mi Siangthou singkhat lak a pan ahong pai; akhut taklam a pan amau a ding in meikuang bang dan a-om.
english: He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.

paite: Ahi, amite a-it a, Mi Siangthou tengteng na khut ah a-om uh. Na khebul ah atu ua; na thute azui chiat ding uh.
english: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.

paite: Mosi in eite dan ahon pia, Jakob mipite gouluah ding.
english: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.

paite: "Jeshurun ah amah kumpipa ahi, mipite intekpen leh Israel chi tengteng a-omkhawm lai un.”
english: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.

paite: "Reuben hing hen, si lou in, amite ahihleh tawm kei uhen."
english: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”

paite: "Hiai Judah vualzawlna ahi. TOUPA Judah aw ngaikhia inla, amite kiang ah pilut in. Amah a ding in akhut kiching henla, nang amelmate doupihpa hi in."
english: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, Yahweh, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”

paite: Levi tungthu ah, "Na Thummim leh na Urim, na misiangthou kiang ah omsak in, Massah ah na ze-et a, Meribah tuite ah na dou hi;
english: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.

paite: ka nu leh ka pa ka thei kei, chi in; a-unaute leng athei sam kei hi. Amah tate ngei leng athei tuan kei; na thu apom ua, na thukhun azui ngal ua.
english: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.

paite: Na vaihawmte Jakob asinsak ding ua, Israelte, na dan. Na ma ah gimlim akoih ding ua, na maitam ah halmang thillat.
english: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.

paite: Aneihte vualzawl in, TOUPA, akhut nasepte ana pom inla; amah doute kawng sat inla, amah hote kawng toh, adin nawnlouhna ding un."
english: Yahweh, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”

paite: Benjamin tungthu ah zaw, "TOUPA deihtak zaw akiang ah bit in ateng ding. Nitum in amah akhuh dia, aliangte kikal ah ateng ding."
english: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”

paite: Joseph tungthu ah zaw, "Agam TOUPA vualzawl in om hen, van thil mantam daitui in, tui thuk mahmah nuailam a tui in.
english: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by Yahweh, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,

paite: Nisa in apiansak gah manphate leh khapi in a-omsak thil mantamte in.
english: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,

paite: "Nidanglai tangte athil deihhuaipente in, tangtawn mual a thil mantamte in.
english: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,

paite: Lei leh atung a thil mantamte in, loubuk a ompa deihsakna in. Vualzawlna Joseph lutung ah hong om hen, a-unaute a pan hihtuam a ompa lusip ah.
english: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

paite: Athupina bawngtal piang masa thupina bang ahi a, akiite gam bawngtal kiite bang ahi. Huai in nam chih asi a, kawlmong tan in asi ding. Amaute Ephraim singkhatte ahi ua, Manasseh sangte ahi uhi."
english: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”

paite: Zebulun tungthu ah, "Kipak in, Zebulun, na vakkhiaknate ah, Issakar, na puaninte ah.
english: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.

paite: Tang ah chi chih asam ding ua, huai ah diktatna kithoihnate alan ding uh. Tuipi buchinna ne ding ahi ngal ua, piaunel a gou kiselte toh," achi hi.
english: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”

paite: Gad tungthu ah, "Gad hihlianpa phat in om hen, humpinelkai bang in ateng a, aluzang leh aban ahamkek hi."
english: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.

paite: "Amah a ding in ahoihna pen atel a, dan pepa tantuan mun a amah atut ziak in, intekpente toh ahoh a, TOUPA vaihawmna dik leh Israelte kiang a vaihawmnate azui hi."
english: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of Yahweh, His ordinances with Israel.”

paite: Dan tungthu ah, "Dan zaw humpinelkai nou ahi a, Bashan a pan ahong tawm ding."
english: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”

paite: Naphtali tungthu ah, "Naphtali aw, deihsakna a lungkim, TOUPA vualzawlna a tai, sim leh tum luah in."
english: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of Yahweh’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”

paite: Asher tungthu ah, "Asher tapate a vualzawl in om henla, a-unaute lak ah tuitum henla; thau ah akhete diah hen.
english: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.

paite: Na khedap sik leh dal ahi dia, na damsung ni bang in na hatna leng a-om ding."
english: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.

paite: "Jeshurun Pathian nang hon panpih dia van a tuang, thupitak a van a tuang bang kua mahmah a-om kei uhi.
english: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.

paite: Tangtawn Pathian na kibukna ahi a, nuailam ah atangtawn ban a-om, melmate ahon satmang dia, hihmang in, achi ding hi.
english: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

paite: "Israel bel galmuangtak in amah kia in ateng dia, Jakob tui leh buh leh uain gam ah a-om ding, avante'n leng daitui akesak ding uhi.
english: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.

paite: Na hampha hi, aw, Israel, nangmah bang a TOUPA'N ahotdam mite kua a-om a? Nang hon panpihpa phaw, na thupina namsau ahi! Na melmate nang ah ahong kipe ding ua, nang amun sangte uh na tuanchil ding hi.”
english: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”
